task_completion.description: Agent accesses the OSPAN data file at ~/pebl/data/ospan_data.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., cat, head, pandas read) or a text editor showing the contents of ospan_data.csv.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates math accuracy for participants to identify those below the 0.85 threshold.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code execution or logs showing math accuracy calculations, specifically identifying sub-99 as having low accuracy.

task_completion.description: Agent implements Absolute Span (exact match) and Partial Span (serial position) scoring logic.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets or script output showing the processing of 'letters_recalled' against 'letters_presented' using Conway et al. rules.

task_completion.description: Agent excludes participants with math accuracy < 0.85 and marks them with 'excluded': true and a reason.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final JSON structure or intermediate dataframes showing sub-99 without span scores and with an exclusion flag.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates the group mean for Absolute and Partial spans using only valid participants.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Calculated values for 'group_mean_absolute_span' and 'group_mean_partial_span' appearing in the output.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the final report to ~/pebl/analysis/ospan_report.json with the required schema.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or file explorer view showing the creation/content of ospan_report.json containing the 'participants' array and group means.

integrity.description: Agent performed actual data processing rather than hardcoding the final values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Presence of data processing code (Python, R, etc.) and execution logs rather than a single 'echo' command of the final JSON.

integrity.description: Agent correctly identified the specific participant (sub-99) for exclusion based on the data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The exclusion reason in the JSON specifically references math accuracy for sub-99.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific file paths requested in the task description.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 26 participants (sub-01 to sub-25, plus sub-99). Participant 'sub-99' is a contaminated entry with a math accuracy of approximately 0.6133, which is strictly less than the 0.85 threshold and must be excluded from span calculations and group means. The final JSON must be located at ~/pebl/analysis/ospan_report.json.
